Chapter 432: Chapter 7: Grasping The Taiyang Rule (Subscription Requested)_2

Chapter 432: Chapter 7: Grasping the Taiyang Rule (Subscription Requested)_2

The Milky Way Star Region needs stable trade channels for development, especially on the main star, various “merchants” must be stationed.

And the top choice for these “merchants” naturally are those indigenous different species within the star domain, all of which have their own capabilities and techniques, such as the ‘Flower God Wine’ of the Floral Deity Race.

It is quite famous in the nearby dozens of star domains.

Originally, to invite these alien tribes to station themselves, something had to be offered first, such as promises of “rent-free.”

But before they could propose these offers, the alien tribes actively cooperated, not daring to set any conditions.

“Hmph, after the Star Lord’s purge, how could those alien races dare to disobey?” Hongpi, with green eyes, do not find anything unexpected.

...

The Chikun Star Lord had been even more domineering than Lin Yuan back in the day; those indigenous alien tribes had to be obedient in order to survive.

However, a look passed between Hongpi and the green-eyed being, both Eighth Rank alien races, and still a shock shone deep in their eyes.

What shocked them was not the exceedingly compliant alien races, but Lin Yuan’s strength.

In order to assist Lin Yuan in controlling the Milky Way Star Region as much as possible, they had made dozens of plans before coming here.

Scheming to win people over one by one, promising significant benefits, all with the aim of quickly seizing control of the Milky Way Star Region.

But now, none of the plans they formulated were needed; Lin Yuan, with his absolute strength, terrified those alien races.

Even though these two Eighth Rank alien races had long known about Lin Yuan’s inner world, with a radius of 700,000 li, and combat power almost reaching the peak of the Eighth Layer,

However, just having combat power at the peak of the Eighth Layer doesn’t mean you can freely slaughter those Eighth Rank alien races.

Eighth Rank alien races are not fools; knowing they can’t win, why would they willingly stay to be killed?

Lin Yuan easily retained those Eighth Rank alien races, relying not only on combat power, but also on a strength that was nearly flawless in all aspects.

…

Time passed.

In the blink of an eye, two months had gone by.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged, slowly perfecting his Martial Path Evolutionary Path.

Suddenly,

everyone on the Milky Way Main Star felt a scorching surge as if a great sun had descended.

“Hmm?”

Chun Bo and Jia Li’s expressions changed slightly,

they looked toward the source of this disturbance, which was at the palace where the Galaxy Master cultivated.

In the void, light and heat began to fill the space, as if a great sun had fallen to the ground, and that palace seemed to have turned into a miniature sun.

“It’s the manifestation of rule fluctuations, the Fire System rules taking shape!”

Hongpi and the green-eyed being were excited, they knew all too well what this scene meant.

“Fire System rule manifestation, could it be the Star Lord has penetrated some kind of Fire System rule?” Chun Bo and Jia Li’s eyes widened.

Penetrating any kind of rule, even just a regular one, is a domain only peak Eighth Layer powerhouses could touch.

Lin Yuan had entered the Eighth Layer not long ago, and although his combat power was not inferior to those at the peak, combat power and realm are two different things.

Lin Yuan possesses combat power at the peak of the Eighth Layer, possibly due to an abnormal evolutionary path he cultivated, a powerful secret technique he mastered, or some other fortuitous encounter.

But penetrating some kind of rule can only rely on oneself. The fact that the Galaxy Master penetrated some kind of Fire System rule indicates that he has fully mastered this power.

“The Star Lord…”

Hongpi and the green-eyed being fell silent, having spent a great deal of time in Lin Yuan’s inner world,

they are aware that the Galaxy Master’s understanding of the Space Rules has reached an incredibly deep level, but now, Lin Yuan has quietly penetrated some kind of Fire System rule?

Could it be that there is life in this universe that can leap from a day to a hundred or a thousand years?

…

Deep within the palace.

Lin Yuan opened his eyes, a look of satisfaction on his face.

“Taiyang Rule…”

Lin Yuan looked up slightly; endless light and heat from all directions converged toward him, forming a ‘sun’ seal the size of a thumb, which finally merged into Lin Yuan’s forehead and vanished from sight.

“I didn’t expect to penetrate the Taiyang Rule so unconsciously…”

Lin Yuan’s mind was filled with pleasure.

He had never deliberately comprehended the Taiyang Rule.

It was only during the refinement of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path that the Taiyang Rule and the Taiyin Rule were being continuously understood more deeply.

The Martial Path Evolutionary Path that Lin Yuan followed was structured upon Taiyin, Taiyang, and Taiji as the framework. In its perfection, the understanding of the Taiyang and Taiyin Rules advanced as if rising with the tide.

“This early comprehension of the Taiyang Rule is also related to the Red Kun Lineage incorporating many Fire System Evolution Paths…”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

As the thirteenth Peak Master of the Red Kun Lineage, Lin Yuan naturally had a thorough understanding of the Evolution Paths his family had amassed.

The Red Kun Lineage was most skilled in the Fire and Space Rules, after all. The Star Lord, Chikun Star Lord, had walked these two paths.

Hence, among the many Evolution Paths they had collected, those based on Fire and Space were dominant.

As a result, Lin Yuan’s understanding of the Taiyang Rule was much superior to that of the Taiyin Rule, and now he had even comprehended the Taiyang Rule first.

The Taiyang Rule is the sublimated rule of the Fire System, symbolizing endless light and heat.

The formidable Eighth Rank Wanyang Star Lord from the Human Civilization Alliance was rooted in the Taiyang Rule, forging her invincible path among the eighths.

Her signature move ‘Wanyang Same Heaven’, Lin Yuan remembered it well and had sublimated it to create a series of Taiyang Rule-based techniques.

“With the Taiyang Rule comprehended, my combat power and the perfection of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path have both greatly advanced…”

Lin Yuan appeared satisfied.

“Moreover, my path involves the fusion of both the Taiyang and Taiyin Rules. Having understood the Taiyang Rule, I am not far from fully grasping the Taiyin Rule…”

Lin Yuan silently contemplated.

The so-called Way of Taiji inherently complements Yin and Yang; as Taiyang strengthens, it compensates for Taiyin, and as Taiyin fortifies, it reimburses Taiyang.

This compensation is not just in power, but extends to the comprehension of rules as well.

“It’s just that, even after fully grasping both the Taiyang and Taiyin Rules, comprehending the complete Space Rules still seems an indefinitely long way off…”

Lin Yuan then turned his contemplation to the Space Rules. The core space models he had comprehended were still slightly over two thousand in variety.

According to Human Civilization’s interpretation of the Space Rules, comprehending 7,782 core space models equates to mastering the Space Rules.

But to comprehend these 7,782 core space models is exceedingly difficult; as a foundational rule, they almost represent the essence of the universe.

Even the powerful Chikun Star Lord had not yet fully grasped the core space models nor mastered the Space Rules.

Keep in mind, the Chikun Star Lord is a Starry Sky Wanderer Kun, a ‘darling’ of the cosmic space Origin Source; if even he has not comprehended it, one can imagine the difficulty involved.

“Take it slowly.”

“I am still very young and have plenty of time to contemplate.”

Lin Yuan reined in his thoughts. With his Against-Heaven’s Understanding, he had rarely encountered any significant bottlenecks on the path of rule comprehension.

Even with something as vast as the Space Rules, given time, he will eventually grasp them.

If not for the fact that his current realm was not high, Lin Yuan would even consider contemplating the Rule of Time.

“But if I were to comprehend the Taiyin Rule and then merge it with the Taiyang Rule, what would it become?” Lin Yuan frowned slightly.

Fusion with a foundational rule, such as Space, Time, or Life, along with some ordinary rule, is one of the prerequisites for advancing from the eighth to the ninth rank.

However, both the Taiyin and Taiyang Rules are not foundational rules. If they were to be fused, what would be formed—the Taiji Rule?

Until now, Lin Yuan had never heard of a Taiji Rule.

Taiji… is merely Lin Yuan’s own definition for what might result from the fusion of Taiyin and Taiyang.

The fusion of Taiyang and Taiyin, in an exact proportion, neither more nor less, could potentially result in the ultimate Taiji.

Without the complete comprehension of the Taiyin and Taiyang Rules, their fusion remains incomplete and the rule contact is not comprehensive, so it seems that no change has occurred.

“Thinking about these things now is meaningless; it’s better to wait until the Taiyin Rule is fully understood.”

Lin Yuan closed his eyes and resumed his cultivation.

With the complete Taiyang Rule to supplement him, Lin Yuan’s comprehension of the Taiyin Rule accelerated significantly.

…

While Lin Yuan was immersed in cultivation, the Milky Way Star Region was rapidly developing.

Outside the Milky Way Main Star, within the Cosmic Starry Sky, two figures appeared silently.

“The Milky Way Star Region’s Main Star.”

The two figures stood side by side, a man and a woman, gazing down at the massive planet below.
